summary: Frontend-only design-polish regression pass for Meridian Plywood. All layout fixes across Hero, Navbar, Footer, Performance, Interiors, Portal, and FloatingWhatsApp verified. Two end-to-end form submissions (dealer + contact) confirmed hitting live /api endpoints and returning 200. Zero console/page errors during the run.

critical_code_review_comments: Portal.jsx (line ~380): focus ring uses a 3px, 0.15-alpha copper box-shadow — visually correct, but the review note said '2.75px @ 0.137 alpha' (per iteration_2). Difference is negligible/imperceptible; flagging only for reference.

Hero.jsx hides the scroll cue below 700px viewport height via the [@media(min-height:700px)]:flex utility. Fine on desktop, and matches the design intent, but on stubby laptop windows (e.g. 1366x680) the cue silently disappears — not a bug, just documenting the intended behaviour so future regressions don't re-flag it.

Pre-existing items from iteration_2 still apply (CORS wildcard + credentials, Three.js deprecation warnings, unauthenticated GET /api/inquiries|dealers|samples). Not touched in this polish pass — no action needed for this iteration.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend at https://plywood-studio.preview.emergentagent.com. All polish fixes from the current review request render as expected — no regressions. Hero collision checks were done at 1920x800 exactly (per request); the scroll cue sits at right:24/28 (data-testid hero-scroll-cue), and the floating WhatsApp button sits at right:4/5/7 (data-testid floating-whatsapp-container). Both stay clear of each other and of the stat row. Portal has two tabs (portal-tab-become-dealer default, portal-tab-samples); portal-sample-whatsapp only mounts after switching to the Samples tab. Contact form success signal is the Sonner toast 'Inquiry received — Our specifications team will respond within one business day.' plus the POST /api/inquiries returning 200. Backend pytest suite from iteration_2 (/app/backend/tests/backend_test.py, 19/19 green) was not re-run in this pass since the review request explicitly scoped this to frontend only.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All polish fixes verified against the review checklist.
